observations: The target is geological faults indicative of geothermal resources; the page does not label geothermal vents or establish a resource discovery.
The metric is distance-weighted Tversky with alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, and a triangular kernel with 300 m support (3 pixels at 100 m).
The submission specification requires one float32 GeoTIFF band, values in [0,1], EPSG:32611, 100 m resolution, matching bounds, and null or NaN outside the bounds.
